headline: Trump administration pauses US visa appointments worldwide
summary: The US State Department has suspended services to launch a global training initiative for consular officers to screen applicants more strictly.
details: The Trump administration has issued a global pause on visa appointments, affecting applicants across the world as part of an ongoing immigration crackdown.
A US State Department spokesperson stated that the pause is to accommodate a global training initiative for consular officers at all US embassies and consulates.
The training aims to help officers better screen out applicants who are likely to become dependent on US public benefits and ensure evaluations are consistent.
Applicants with scheduled interviews have already begun receiving emails notifying them that their appointments are being rescheduled.
This move comes amid an aggressive deportation drive and the revocation of visas and green cards for various reasons, including political opinions.
Human rights groups have condemned the crackdown, calling it discriminatory and a violation of free speech and due process rights.
While the administration focuses on stopping illegal immigration, it has also made legal immigration more difficult by imposing new and expensive fees for certain work visas.
caption:
US visa appointments are paused worldwide. The Trump administration is tightening screening processes for all applicants.

The Trump administration has issued a global pause on visa appointments, affecting applicants across the world as part of an ongoing immigration crackdown.

A US State Department spokesperson stated that the pause is to accommodate a global training initiative for consular officers at all US embassies and consulates.

The training aims to help officers better screen out applicants who are likely to become dependent on US public benefits and ensure evaluations are consistent.

Applicants with scheduled interviews have already begun receiving emails notifying them that their appointments are being rescheduled.

This move comes amid an aggressive deportation drive and the revocation of visas and green cards for various reasons, including political opinions.

Human rights groups have condemned the crackdown, calling it discriminatory and a violation of free speech and due process rights.

While the administration focuses on stopping illegal immigration, it has also made legal immigration more difficult by imposing new and expensive fees for certain work visas.

headline: 550 new dengue cases reported in 24 hours
summary: The Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) reports a surge in admissions across various divisions, with Dhaka division seeing the highest numbers.
details: According to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), 550 people were admitted to hospitals with dengue fever in the last 24 hours. No deaths were reported during this period.

// Dhaka division (outside city corporations) recorded 215 cases, while Dhaka North and South City Corporations saw 49 and 84 cases respectively. Other divisions including Chattogram (102), Mymensingh (45), Khulna (38), and Barishal (6) also reported admissions.
